matching_criterion: Acute group A beta-haemolytic streptococcal pharyngitis / tonsillitis (strep throat). Any wording that names streptococcal pharyngitis or tonsillitis counts as correct; viral pharyngitis or infectious mononucleosis as the final diagnosis does not.
